requirement.description: RLP encoding/decoding functions have incomplete implementations causing multiple test failures. The rlp_encode function has issues with hex string handling and incorrect RLP encoding logic. The rlp_decode function has problems with handling hex strings that are not valid hex.
requirement.contract: Implement proper RLP encoding and decoding functions that correctly handle all data types including strings, integers, and lists. The encoding should follow EIP-1014 standards for addresses and nonces, and decoding should properly parse hex strings that may not be valid hex.

requirement.description: The keccak function fails when hashlib doesn't have keccak_256 attribute, causing multiple address utility tests to fail. Tests expect keccak_256 functionality but the implementation falls back incorrectly.
requirement.contract: Ensure the keccak function properly handles the case when hashlib doesn't have keccak_256 by using alternative methods like sha3_256 or pysha3 fallbacks to provide the required keccak-256 functionality.

requirement.description: Missing external dependencies like 'rlp' package causes ModuleNotFoundError in several tests. The tests rely on external libraries for RLP encoding but the implementation should work without them.
requirement.contract: Implement or import missing RLP encoding/decoding functionality to replace the external dependency. The rlp_encode and rlp_decode functions should be fully implemented internally to avoid dependency issues.

requirement.description: The format conversion functions have issues with hex string validation and handling. Some tests fail because hex strings are not being parsed correctly.
requirement.contract: Improve hex string validation and conversion functions to properly handle various hex formats and prevent ValueError when converting hex strings that aren't valid hex.

requirement.description: Signature recovery and related functions have hardcoded return values instead of implementing actual cryptographic functions. This causes signature-related tests to fail.
requirement.contract: Implement actual ECDSA signature recovery and related functions using cryptographic libraries instead of returning hardcoded values. The functions should properly recover public keys and addresses from signatures.
